why: No route can land until a second app builds, tests and installs next to the old one. The chain plumbing is v3-argo-chain; this Issue is the app, its install, its DOM harness and its gate.
what: An empty apps/dashboard-v3 (@argo/dashboard-v3) that builds, serves at /v3/ and runs DOM tests; `check-v3`; scripts/check-test-port.ts.
must_not_touch: apps/dashboard-v3/src/** except the two files named
contract: migration-release.md 6.1, 6.2; v3-cli-sibling built the install. package.json declares `"basalt": {"sibling": true}` and basalt-ui exact 3.0.0-next.N (N = floors.G2.next in basalt-ui scripts/fleet.json); the root package.json gains `"basalt": {"app": "apps/dashboard"}`; root .basalt/ and .oxlintrc.json stay. DOM harness (argo has none): devDependencies happy-dom and @happy-dom/global-registrator at basalt-ui's root pins (`npm view` first); bunfig.toml preloads test/setup.ts, which registers the global and calls basalt-ui/testing `installDomShims` (installed docs/testing.md); tests render through `renderApp`. happy-dom has no layout: geometry is design-shot or the owner, never a DOM test.
change: 1. `basalt-ui init --profile app` in the app dir: Vite base /v3/, tsr.config.json (routesDirectory ./src/routes, tree ./src/routeTree.gen.ts), .env.local.tpl and vite-env.d.ts copied, a stub main.tsx. 2. Makefile `check-v3` (app bin sync --check, doctor, lint, typecheck, build, test) called from `check`. 3. scripts/check-test-port.ts <oldDir> <newDir>: pairs each old *.test.ts(x) with its new one (`--only <glob>` narrows both sides to old paths matching it), strips import statements, exits 1 on a missing port or any other differing line unless it carries a `// port: <reason>` marker, prints the marker count. 4. One smoke test through renderApp. Rule: import-boundary bans apps/dashboard. Skill snippet: the generated AGENTS.md block.
commits: Argo ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body, worked around in app code.
proof: `make deploy DRY_RUN=1` plans both builds; after the factory deploy `make version` = origin/master and `make verify` exits 0.
acceptance: `./node_modules/.bin/basalt-ui sync --check` at the repo root exits 0 with both apps present
`make check` exits 0 and runs the check-v3 steps
`bun --cwd apps/dashboard-v3 test` exits 0 with a smoke test through renderApp
`bun test scripts/check-test-port.test.ts` proves: an import-only diff passes, an unmarked changed line fails, a marked one passes and is counted
`APP=dashboard-v3 make design-shot ROUTES="/"` exits 0 and writes a board
`make verify-pages BASE=http://127.0.0.1:7737/v3 ROUTES=/` reports PASS after the factory deploy (else state not-run)
package.json files carry basalt.sibling (app) and basalt.app (root); no `mantine` string in apps/dashboard-v3
out_of_scope: Routes, stores, the /v3/ mount (v3-argo-chain), deleting the old app.
